exposure: Amniotic fluid L-type fatty acid-binding protein (L-FABP) levels
FGR without fetal blood flow abnormalities (healthy-FGR group)
FGR with fetal blood flow abnormalities (FGR group)
Fetal growth restriction (FGR) with and without fetal blood flow abnormalities
finding: Amniotic fluid L-FABP level was significantly higher in the FGR group compared to that in the healthy-FGR and control groups, suggesting its potential as a predictive marker of fetal condition.
